items.t: Automatic slipping or missing gears (TSB 02-13-8)
items.note: If only a valve body or servo repair is needed, cost is much lower.

items.t: Cruise control deactivation switch can overheat and catch fire (recalls 09V-399, 07V-336, 06V-286)
items.job: Disconnect or replace switch and add fused jumper harness
items.note: Usually free under Ford's recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Timing chain rattle from worn guides and tensioners
items.job: Replace timing chains, guides and tensioners
items.note: The rear chain needs the engine pulled. A front-only repair costs less.

items.t: Running board courtesy light wiring can overheat (recall 03V-094)
items.job: Repair running board light wiring and add protection
items.note: Usually free under Ford's recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Transmission fluid leak at the cooler line fitting (TSB 01-10-2)
items.job: Replace transmission cooler line fitting and top off fluid

items.t: Liftgate glass hinges and panel crack (recall 04S20)
items.note: Usually covered by Ford's program. Check your VIN first. A broken glass costs more.

items.t: 5R55W/5R55S five-speed slipping, no third gear or harsh reverse
items.note: Some are fixed with a servo bore or valve body repair, which costs much less.

items.t: Harsh or lunging shifts (TSB 07-6-3)
items.job: Reprogram powertrain computer per Ford bulletin

items.t: Shifter stuck in Park (TSB 06-25-10)
items.job: Replace shift interlock solenoid or shifter part

items.t: Steering gear mounting bolts may break (recall 07V-181)
items.note: Usually free under Ford's recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Transmission cooler line bolt can loosen (recall 07V-453)
items.job: Tighten or replace cooler line bolt and refill fluid
items.note: Usually free under Ford's recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Front seat recliner may not hold (recall 10V-161)
items.note: Usually free under Ford's recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Sluggish take-off and harsh bump at low speed (TSB 11-12-10)
items.job: Reprogram powertrain computer per Ford bulletin

items.t: Sudden loss of power steering assist (recall 14V-286)
items.note: Recall or extended coverage may apply; check your VIN. Some are fixed with software.

items.t: Front door may unlatch in a side crash (recall 15V-171)
items.note: Price is per door. Usually free under Ford's recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: "Shift to Park" message and dead battery (TSBs 15-0047, 17-2219)
items.job: Repair shifter park-detect switch or install shifter repair kit

items.t: Exhaust smell inside the cabin (NHTSA EA17-002, Ford program 17N03)
items.job: Reseal rear body seams and update climate control settings
items.note: Ford's program did this work free for many owners. Ask a dealer with your VIN.

items.t: Internal water pump leaks coolant into the oil
items.job: Replace internal water pump, flush oil and coolant
items.note: Cost rises a lot if coolant reached the bearings and the engine must be replaced.

items.t: AWD transfer unit (PTU) leaks and overheats (TSB 18-2255)
items.job: Replace PTU seals, vent and fluid
items.note: If the PTU itself has failed and must be replaced, expect much more.

items.t: Rear toe link can fracture (recalls 19V-435, 26V-101)
items.job: Replace both rear toe links and align
items.note: Usually free under Ford's recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: A-pillar trim can come loose (recall 24V-031)
items.job: Reattach A-pillar trim with new clips
items.note: Usually free under Ford's recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Long cranking and harsh cold downshifts (TSB 13-5-31)
items.job: Reprogram powertrain computer per Ford bulletin

items.t: Fuel delivery module can crack and leak (recalls 13V-227, 15V-812)
items.note: Usually free under Ford's recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Parking brake may not fully apply (recall 15V-464)
items.job: Adjust or replace parking brake cable
items.note: Usually free under Ford's recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Roof rail covers can loosen and fly off (recalls 21V-316, 26V-448)
items.job: Reattach roof rail covers with new clips or adhesive
items.note: Usually free under Ford's recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Engine block heater can leak coolant and short (recalls 25V-685, 26V-012)
items.note: Usually free under Ford's recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Turbo oil supply tube may leak (recall 16V-925)
items.note: Usually free under Ford's recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Fuel pressure sensor may leak (recall 18V-807)
items.note: Usually free under Ford's recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Seat recliner may not lock (recall 19V-633)
items.note: Usually free under Ford's recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Rear driveshaft may fracture (recall 20V-693)
items.note: Usually free under Ford's recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Rear lower control arm bolts may break (recall 21V-154)
items.job: Replace rear lower control arm bolts
items.note: Usually free under Ford's recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Park pawl may engage while moving (recall 26V-402)
items.note: Usually free under Ford's recall. If the transmission was damaged, expect much more.

items.t: Rear axle bolt can break (recalls 22V-255, 23V-199, 23V-675)
items.note: Usually free under Ford's recalls. Some recalls add a software update. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Engine computer reset can cut power (recall 23V-069)
items.note: Usually free under Ford's recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Windshield wiper motor can fail (recall 26V-117)
items.note: Usually free under Ford's recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Rearview or 360-degree camera image fails (several recalls)
items.note: Usually free under Ford's recalls. Some are fixed with software only. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Second-row seat belt anchor bolts (recalls 25V-093, 26V-159)
items.job: Tighten or replace seat belt anchor bolts
items.note: Usually free under Ford's recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Intake valve can break (recall 24V-635)
items.note: Recall inspects the engine. A broken valve usually means a new engine. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Low-pressure fuel pump can fail (recall 25V-455)
items.note: Usually free under Ford's recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Fuel line or filler tube may come loose (recalls 22V-685, 22V-088)
items.job: Reconnect fuel line or secure filler tube
items.note: Usually free under Ford's recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Loose transmission bolt may stop Park from engaging (recall 23V-070)
items.job: Replace park pawl abutment bolt in transmission
items.note: Usually free under Ford's recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Turbo oil supply line may leak (recall 23V-597)
items.note: Usually free under Ford's recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Transmission valve body machining error (recall 25V-164)
items.note: Usually free under Ford's recall. If the transmission must be replaced, expect much more.

items.t: Powertrain computer reset while driving (recalls 26V-371, 25V-239)
items.note: Usually free under Ford's recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Trailer hitch bolts may be loose (recall 25V-687)
items.job: Tighten or replace trailer hitch bolts
items.note: Usually free under Ford's recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Front brake caliper and chassis bolts (recalls 25V-371, 25V-316, 25V-020)
items.job: Replace front caliper and chassis bolts
items.note: Usually free under Ford's recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Engine failure from bearing or connecting rod defects (recalls 25V-344, 26V-343)
items.note: Covered by recall or new-vehicle warranty for these years. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Adaptive headlights may turn the wrong way (recall 26V-121)
items.note: Usually free under Ford's recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Driver seat may recline on its own (recall 26V-470)
items.note: Usually free under Ford's recall. Check your VIN first.
